results_page.label: Tennessee Secretary of State: election results

feeds.note: 2026-10-09: 403 'The request could not be satisfied' from CloudFront to the honest User-Agent, as CLAUDE.md records for sos.tn.gov and its file host. The Browser pane is not allowed this site (CLAUDE.md), so it was not opened.

races_in_feed: unknown on the live site; Tennessee's counties elect their offices in August, so November local contests are mostly city races on county commissions' ballots
local: Yes, 95 county election commissions: Shelby (shelbyvote.gov), Davidson (nashville.gov/departments/elections), Knox (knoxcounty.org/election), Hamilton (elect.hamiltontn.gov); results pages not checked
how_counted: County election commissions report to the Secretary of State on the night and certify by the third Monday after the election.

certify.body: the Governor, Secretary of State and Attorney General of Tennessee
certify.rule: Meet as soon as the returns are received (Tenn. Code 2-8-110(a)).
certify.local_rule: County commissions certify by the third Monday after the election (2-8-101).
certify.source: NCSL, 'Election Certification Deadlines' (www.ncsl.org/elections-and-campaigns/certification-deadlines), read 2026-10-10; secondary: a summary of each state's law, not the law itself
